measurement_contract.applications: Each client and peer verifies every request/response byte; final client write-half-close precedes the final response read, followed by checked EOF.
measurement_contract.capture: Only two selected client socket cookies per epoch; third client is in the same cgroup and at the same listener endpoint. Kernel records carry payload length and up to 64 actual prefix bytes.
measurement_contract.oracle: Per-cookie TCP sequence and payload lengths cover expected contiguous byte ranges; each prefix matches the expected stream offset. Kernel/consumer/runtime event totals reconcile independently of logical messages.
measurement_contract.sequence_origin: First selected payload provides the initial TCP sequence; full expected byte-count equality detects missing initial/final ranges. SYN/ACK origin inference and general reassembly are not claimed.
